units: <cite ref="Berakhot 59b:1">Ber. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בתקופתה</he> the sun starting on his new cycle (of twenty eight years).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:3">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>י״ב הדשים לח׳</he> the twelve solar months.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:7">Ned. III, 7</cite> <he>רואי הח׳</he> those seeing (or feeling) the sun; <he>שלא נתכוין … שהח׳ וכ׳</he> for he meant him whom the sun sees; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:4">Yeb. VIII, 4</cite>, a. fr. <he>סריס ח׳</he> a eunuch from the time of seeing the sun, i.e. born without visible testicles; opp. to <he>סריס אדם</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:5:3">Y. Sabb. XIX, end, 17ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01021"><he>אָחַז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:4">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="A00021"><he>אַבְאָבִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:10:3">Y. Sabb. I, end, 4ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>פת חמה חַמָּתָהּ בצדה</he> hot bread has its heat by its side, i.e. eating hot bread causes fever; a. fr.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:13">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="H01141"><he>חַמָּא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="H01238"><he>חַמַּת</he></cite>.
